tasks.subject: Task 0: Monorepo Scaffold
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Working Turborepo monorepo with Next.js web app, Expo mobile app, and shared types package.

**Files:**
- Create: `turbo.json`, `package.json`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
- Create: `apps/web/` (Next.js 15)
- Create: `apps/mobile/` (Expo SDK 52)
- Create: `packages/shared/src/types.ts`, `palette.ts`, `index.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `pnpm dev` starts both apps
- [ ] shared types importable with no TS errors
- [ ] `pnpm build` completes

```json:metadata
{"files":["turbo.json","package.json","apps/web/","apps/mobile/","packages/shared/src/types.ts","packages/shared/src/palette.ts"],"verifyCommand":"pnpm --filter shared build","acceptanceCriteria":["pnpm dev starts both apps","shared types importable","pnpm build completes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Supabase Schema & Storage
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Supabase project with DB schema, RLS, storage buckets, generated types.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql`
- Create: `supabase/migrations/002_rls_policies.sql`
- Create: `supabase/migrations/003_storage_buckets.sql`
- Create: `packages/shared/src/database.types.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 4 tables created
- [ ] RLS enabled
- [ ] 2 storage buckets
- [ ] TS types generated

```json:metadata
{"files":["supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql","supabase/migrations/002_rls_policies.sql","supabase/migrations/003_storage_buckets.sql","packages/shared/src/database.types.ts"],"verifyCommand":"supabase db diff","acceptanceCriteria":["4 tables created","RLS enabled","2 storage buckets","TS types generated"]}
```
